greeting: Good morning, Zae. Welcome home: Express Debark this morning, then the Greyhound north to Tallahassee.

calendar.note: Tampa arrival and Express Debark; Greyhound home; soft landing in Tallahassee

events.title: Carnival Paradise arrives Tampa. Express Debark: carry your own bags and leave the cabin around 8:30 AM.
Morning Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Tyrosine, L-Theanine, two Omega soft gels, Vitamin D3 + K2, and B-Complex if you packed them.
Uber to Hart North Platform, 1315 N Marion St, Tampa. Be there with time to spare for the bus.
Afternoon Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Tyrosine and one or two Omega soft gels. Creatine 5g any time today.
Arrive Tallahassee. Foggy mild morning around 73°F, warming toward about 80°F, low rain chance; sunset 5:46 PM.
Night Supplements (10/10 Plan): L-Theanine and three Neuro-Mag capsules. Soft landing night at home.

projectMove.title: Home day; Arena Phase 30 still waiting on Grok Build balance
projectMove.body: While you were at sea, Phases 25 through 29 finished with green builds. Phase 30 (progression, XP, achievements, cosmetics) is still paused on a Grok Build usage wall from Tuesday; Testarossa resumes the moment balance returns. A top-up restarts the conveyor sooner than waiting on the next weekly reset.

tip.title: Express off the ship, then Hart North by 10:30
tip.body: Carry everything yourself under Express Debark, vacate the cabin around 8:30 AM, and Uber to Hart North Platform at 1315 N Marion St so you are there by about 10:30 for the 11:10 Greyhound to Tallahassee (booking 3398153238, seat 6A).

surprise.title: While you were at sea, the Arena grew five phases
surprise.body: Since you sailed on Sunday, the Arena Battlegrounds remake finished five full build phases with green builds: competitive balance and discipline matchups (Phase 25), the complete main menu and settings (26), Free Duel with custom rules and practice (27), the Arcade Tournament with championship brackets (28), and the Story Campaign, Fracture of the Five Seals (29). Phase 30, player progression with XP, achievements, spell unlocks, and cosmetics, got partway in on Tuesday before the build tool ran out of usage, and it picks up again with a top-up or the next weekly reset. Back home in Tallahassee it is a foggy, mild morning around 73°F, warming to about 80°F this afternoon with only an 11% chance of rain, and the sun sets at 5:46 PM. Welcome back, Zae.

source.label: Arena build logs from the team; Open-Meteo forecast for Tallahassee, Nov 5
